description: The third structural question, after composition and enclosure: was something READ OUT of this value on the way here? The environment is where a process keeps its secrets, and handing it over whole hands over all of them -- but one variable published deliberately is ordinary, and a rule that could not tell the difference would report the ordinary case. The IR already recorded a property read as its own flow kind, so asking needed no new fact.

expected.note: the whole environment reaches the response body
wrapping it in an object changes nothing about what is in it
